[[File:Unnamedscannertechs2.png|thumb|right|270px|Rebel controllers at [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Station]]]]
'''Controller''' was the title given to officers who operated as space traffic controllers in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Their job was to clear, direct and track traffic around Imperial [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. Controllers were also assigned to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] units; in this capacity they acted to coordinate the targeting data and attack vectors of all craft within their sphere of responsibility, in keeping with Imperial tactical doctrine.

[[Jhoff/Legends|Jhoff]] served as the space traffic controller aboard the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] around the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and was responsible for the control of traffic around the ''Executor'' and [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

Besides the Galactic Empire, the Rebel Alliance also made use of the title. Several were stationed at Massassi Station around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The rebel controllers on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] monitored the flight pattern of ships during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. They used the [[OrC-19 com-scan integrator console]].
